gold_note: Sauropodomorph cladogram, read by eye. Multi-way nodes: six plateosaurids; Aardonyx, Mussaurus, the Eucnemesaurus pair and the rest; Camelotia, Leonerasaurus, Melanorosaurus, the Antetonitrus-Lessemsaurus pair and the rest; Isanosaurus, Tazoudasaurus, Vulcanodon and the rest; five eusauropods. The star marks a node and carries no name. 54 tips, 5 polytomies (6, 4, 5, 4, 5 children). Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
